name: +1/+1 counters
description: Green, white and black creatures that arrive with +1/+1 counters, spread them with proliferate and move them about, with rewards for every creature that has grown.

cards.name: Oriel Thornmantle, Grove Warden
cards.rule_text:
Whenever another creature you control enters, put a +1/+1 counter on it.
At the beginning of your end step, if you control three or more creatures with +1/+1 counters on them, draw a card.

cards.name: Hesk, Marrow Gardener
cards.rule_text:
Whenever another creature you control dies, if it had +1/+1 counters on it, put those counters on target creature you control.
{1}{B}, Sacrifice another creature with a +1/+1 counter on it: Draw a card.
cards.flavor_text: Nothing in his garden is ever wasted.

cards.name: Hedge Squire
cards.rule_text: When CARDNAME enters, put a +1/+1 counter on target creature you control.

cards.name: Bramblehide Boar
cards.rule_text:
Trample
CARDNAME enters with a +1/+1 counter on it.
cards.flavor_text: It grows a little meaner every season.

cards.name: Rising Sap
cards.rule_text:
Choose one or both —
• Put a +1/+1 counter on target creature you control.
• Proliferate. (Choose any number of permanents and/or players, then give each another counter of each kind already there.)

cards.name: Mossbound Chorister
cards.rule_text: {1}{G}, {T}: Proliferate. Activate only as a sorcery. (Choose any number of permanents and/or players, then give each another counter of each kind already there.)

cards.name: Swellroot Druid
cards.rule_text:
{T}: Add {G}.
{3}{G}, {T}: Put a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control. Activate only as a sorcery.

cards.name: Dawnwing Instructor
cards.rule_text:
Flying
When CARDNAME enters, put a +1/+1 counter on each of up to two other target creatures you control.

cards.name: Graft-Hand Healer
cards.rule_text: {1}, {T}: Move a +1/+1 counter from target creature you control onto another target creature you control.

cards.name: Duskvine Exchanger
cards.rule_text: When CARDNAME enters, put a -1/-1 counter on up to one target creature an opponent controls and a +1/+1 counter on up to one target creature you control.

cards.name: Envious Blight
cards.rule_text: Target creature gets -2/-2 until end of turn. If you control a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it, that creature gets -4/-4 until end of turn instead.
cards.flavor_text: What it cannot have, it withers.

cards.name: Ripening Hour
cards.rule_text: Put a +1/+1 counter on target creature you control. Then if its power is 4 or greater, draw a card.

cards.name: Gravesap Vintner
cards.rule_text: Whenever a creature you control with a +1/+1 counter on it dies, each opponent loses 2 life and you gain 2 life.

cards.name: Oath of the Tall Grass
cards.rule_text:
At the beginning of combat on your turn, put a +1/+1 counter on target creature you control.
Creatures you control with +1/+1 counters on them have trample.

cards.name: Call the Grown Ranks
cards.rule_text: Create two 1/1 white Soldier creature tokens, then put a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.

cards.name: Brennia, Bloomwarden
cards.rule_text:
+1: Put a +1/+1 counter on up to one target creature. It gains vigilance and trample until end of turn.
−2: Create a 2/2 green Wolf creature token, then put a +1/+1 counter on it.
−7: Put three +1/+1 counters on each creature you control, then proliferate.

cards.name: Elder of Many Rings
cards.rule_text:
Trample
When CARDNAME enters, put two +1/+1 counters on each other creature you control.
cards.flavor_text: Each ring a year, each year a little stronger.

cards.name: Briarcrown Hydra
cards.rule_text:
Trample
CARDNAME enters with X +1/+1 counters on it.
Whenever one or more +1/+1 counters are put on another creature you control, put a +1/+1 counter on CARDNAME.

cards.name: Proving Meadow
cards.rule_text:
{T}: Add {C}.
{4}, {T}: Put a +1/+1 counter on target creature you control. Activate only as a sorcery.
cards.flavor_text: Everyone who trains here leaves a little taller.
